name: @playarr-tv/api-client
description: Real typed client for the Playarr Server API, generated from backend/openapi/playarr.yaml with openapi-typescript (types) + openapi-fetch (thin typed fetch wrapper). `src/generated/schema.ts` is generated output (run `pnpm run generate` to refresh it against the spec); `src/index.ts` is a hand-written ApiClient wrapper over it, and `src/hooks.ts` (subpath export `./react`) holds shared React data-fetching hooks reused by the TV app shells and the standalone web app.
